definition: used before a noun to show that you mean a particular person or thing
sentence: Please close {the} door when you leave.
translation: Пожалуйста, закрой дверь, когда будешь уходить.

definition: used to say who or what someone or something is, or where they are
sentence: I want to {be} a doctor when I grow up.
translation: Я хочу быть врачом, когда вырасту.

definition: used before a verb, or before the place that someone or something reaches
sentence: We are going {to} the station by bus.
translation: Мы едем на вокзал на автобусе.

definition: used to join two words or parts of a sentence together
sentence: I bought bread, milk {and} eggs this morning.
translation: Сегодня утром я купил хлеб, молоко и яйца.

definition: belonging to something, or being a part that makes up something
sentence: The roof {of} the house is red.
translation: Крыша дома красная.

definition: used before one person or thing when it is new in the talk
sentence: She has {a} cat and two dogs.
translation: У неё есть кошка и две собаки.

definition: not outside a room, box or other space, or during a period of time
sentence: The keys are {in} my bag.
translation: Ключи у меня в сумке.

definition: the word a person uses to talk about himself or herself
sentence: Tomorrow {i} will visit my grandmother.
translation: Завтра я навещу бабушку.

definition: used to point at a person or thing which is not near you
sentence: Can you see {that} bird on the roof?
translation: Видишь ту птицу на крыше?

definition: used to show who gets something, or the purpose of something
sentence: This present is {for} my sister.
translation: Этот подарок для моей сестры.

definition: to own something, or to hold or contain it
sentence: They {have} a small house by the sea.
translation: У них есть маленький дом у моря.

definition: the person or people that someone is speaking to
sentence: Are {you} coming to the party tonight?
translation: Ты придёшь сегодня на вечеринку?

definition: used for a thing, animal or idea that has already been mentioned
sentence: Where is my phone? I left {it} here.
translation: Где мой телефон? Я оставил его здесь.

definition: touching the top or surface of something, or used with days and dates
sentence: Your book is {on} the table.
translation: Твоя книга на столе.

definition: together or near someone, or using something to do a job
sentence: I went to the cinema {with} my friends.
translation: Я ходил в кино с друзьями.

definition: used to point at a person or thing that is near you
sentence: {This} apple is sweeter than the other one.
translation: Это яблоко слаще другого.

definition: while something else happens, or because
sentence: The phone rang {as} I was leaving.
translation: Телефон зазвонил, когда я уходил.

definition: used to say where something is or when something happens
sentence: Meet me {at} the bus stop at nine.
translation: Встретимся на остановке в девять.

definition: a man, boy or male animal that has already been mentioned
sentence: Tom is my brother; {he} is a teacher.
translation: Том — мой брат, он учитель.

definition: used to make a word or sentence negative
sentence: I am {not} hungry right now.
translation: Я сейчас не голоден.

definition: to perform an action or job
sentence: What do you {do} at the weekend?
translation: Чем ты занимаешься на выходных?

definition: next to something, or used to say who or what did something
sentence: The book was written {by} a young woman.
translation: Книга написана молодой женщиной.

definition: used to add something that is different from what was just said
sentence: The coat is nice, {but} it is too expensive.
translation: Пальто красивое, но слишком дорогое.

definition: used to show where someone or something starts or comes out of
sentence: She comes {from} a small town in Spain.
translation: Она из маленького городка в Испании.

definition: belonging to me
sentence: This is {my} favorite song of all time.
translation: Это моя самая любимая песня.

definition: used between two choices, when only one of them is possible
sentence: Do you want tea {or} coffee?
translation: Ты будешь чай или кофе?

definition: the speaker and one or more other people
sentence: {We} are going to the beach tomorrow.
translation: Завтра мы идём на пляж.

definition: belonging to the person or people you are talking to
sentence: Is this {your} coat on the chair?
translation: Это твоё пальто на стуле?

definition: used instead of "a" before a word that begins with a vowel sound
sentence: I eat {an} apple every morning.
translation: Я ем яблоко каждое утро.

definition: used before the result of an action, or to mean "in order that"
sentence: It was raining, {so} we stayed at home.
translation: Шёл дождь, поэтому мы остались дома.

definition: every one of a group, or the whole of something
sentence: {All} the students passed the exam.
translation: Все ученики сдали экзамен.

definition: to receive or obtain something, or to become
sentence: Did you {get} my message yesterday?
translation: Ты получил вчера моё сообщение?

definition: belonging to a man, boy or male animal
sentence: Peter lost {his} keys again this morning.
translation: Сегодня утром Питер снова потерял свои ключи.

definition: the people, animals or things that have already been mentioned
sentence: My parents are old, but {they} still travel.
translation: Мои родители старые, но они всё ещё путешествуют.

definition: the number 1; a single person or thing
sentence: I have only {one} brother and no sisters.
translation: У меня только один брат и нет сестёр.

definition: the person who is speaking, when they receive the action
sentence: Can you help {me} with this box?
translation: Можешь помочь мне с этой коробкой?

definition: used to talk about something that may happen or may be true
sentence: {If} it rains, we will stay inside.
translation: Если пойдёт дождь, мы останемся дома.

definition: to be able to do something, or to be allowed to
sentence: She {can} speak three languages very well.
translation: Она умеет очень хорошо говорить на трёх языках.

definition: used to talk about the future, or to say what you are ready to do
sentence: I {will} call you tomorrow morning.
translation: Я позвоню тебе завтра утром.

definition: only, or a very short time ago, or exactly
sentence: I {just} want a glass of water.
translation: Я просто хочу стакан воды.

definition: similar to, or in the same way as
sentence: He looks {like} his father when he smiles.
translation: Когда он улыбается, он похож на отца.

definition: to produce or create something, or to cause something to happen
sentence: Let me {make} you a cup of tea.
translation: Давай я сделаю тебе чашку чая.

definition: of high quality, pleasant, or doing what is right
sentence: This is a {good} restaurant with friendly staff.
translation: Это хороший ресторан с приветливым персоналом.

definition: on the subject of, or near a number
sentence: We talked {about} our holiday plans.
translation: Мы говорили о планах на отпуск.

definition: towards or in a higher place
sentence: The cat ran {up} the tree.
translation: Кошка забралась на дерево.

definition: to move or travel to another place
sentence: We {go} to school by bus every day.
translation: Мы каждый день ездим в школу на автобусе.

definition: away from the inside of a place
sentence: The dog ran {out} the door into the garden.
translation: Собака выбежала через дверь в сад.

definition: used to ask which thing or which kind of thing
sentence: {What} time does the film start?
translation: Во сколько начинается фильм?

definition: at what time, or at the time that something happens
sentence: {When} does the shop open on Sundays?
translation: Когда открывается магазин по воскресеньям?

definition: to speak words, or to tell someone something
sentence: What did she {say} about the new plan?
translation: Что она сказала о новом плане?

definition: the thing measured in minutes, hours, days and years, or a particular moment
sentence: What {time} does the train leave tonight?
translation: Во сколько сегодня вечером отходит поезд?

definition: to a greater degree, or used to form comparatives
sentence: This book is {more} interesting than the film.
translation: Эта книга интереснее фильма.

definition: used to say there is zero of something, or as the opposite of yes
sentence: There is {no} milk in the fridge.
translation: В холодильнике нет молока.

definition: used to ask or talk about which person
sentence: {Who} is that man by the window?
translation: Кто тот мужчина у окна?

definition: belonging to the people or things already mentioned
sentence: The children left {their} toys on the floor.
translation: Дети оставили свои игрушки на полу.

definition: in or to that place, or used to say that something exists
sentence: Put the box over {there} by the wall.
translation: Поставь коробку вон туда, к стене.

definition: belonging to a woman, girl or female animal
sentence: Anna lost {her} phone on the train.
translation: Анна потеряла свой телефон в поезде.

definition: used to ask or talk about one of a group of things
sentence: {Which} road leads to the station?
translation: Какая дорога ведёт к вокзалу?

definition: to notice something with your eyes, or to understand
sentence: Can you {see} the mountains from here?
translation: Отсюда видно горы?

definition: used to talk about a possible or imagined situation, or for polite requests
sentence: I {would} love a cup of coffee.
translation: Я бы с удовольствием выпил чашку кофе.

definition: to have information about something, or to be familiar with a person
sentence: I {know} the answer to this question.
translation: Я знаю ответ на этот вопрос.

definition: a period of twelve months, or 365 days
sentence: We moved to this city a {year} ago.
translation: Мы переехали в этот город год назад.

definition: a woman, girl or female animal that has already been mentioned
sentence: Mary is my sister; {she} lives in London.
translation: Мэри — моя сестра, она живёт в Лондоне.

definition: recently made, bought or started, or not known before
sentence: I bought a {new} phone last week.
translation: На прошлой неделе я купил новый телефон.

definition: men, women and children in general
sentence: Many {people} were waiting for the bus.
translation: Много людей ждали автобус.

definition: to pick something up and carry it, or to accept or use something
sentence: {Take} an umbrella; it may rain.
translation: Возьми зонт, может пойти дождь.

definition: in what way, or used to ask about amount, size or condition
sentence: {How} do you get to work every day?
translation: Как ты добираешься на работу каждый день?

definition: different from the one already mentioned, or the rest of a group
sentence: The {other} students are still in the classroom.
translation: Остальные ученики ещё в классе.

definition: to do something with a tool, object or method for a purpose
sentence: You can {use} my pen if you want.
translation: Можешь воспользоваться моей ручкой, если хочешь.

definition: an amount or number of a thing that is not exact, or a few
sentence: Would you like {some} tea with your cake?
translation: Хочешь чаю к пирогу?

definition: in addition; as well
sentence: She speaks French and {also} German.
translation: Она говорит по-французски, а также по-немецки.

definition: the people, animals or things already mentioned, when they receive the action
sentence: The kids are hungry, so give {them} some bread.
translation: Дети голодные, дай им немного хлеба.

definition: to wish to have or do something
sentence: I {want} to learn to play the guitar.
translation: Я хочу научиться играть на гитаре.

definition: to do a job, or to operate correctly
sentence: My parents {work} at the hospital.
translation: Мои родители работают в больнице.

definition: at the present moment
sentence: I am busy {now}, but I can call you later.
translation: Я сейчас занят, но могу позвонить тебе позже.

definition: to move towards the person who is speaking, or to arrive
sentence: Please {come} to my house for dinner.
translation: Пожалуйста, приходи ко мне на ужин.

definition: belonging to a thing, animal or idea already mentioned
sentence: The dog wagged {its} tail happily.
translation: Собака радостно виляла хвостом.

definition: belonging to the speaker and other people
sentence: {Our} house is at the end of the street.
translation: Наш дом в конце улицы.

definition: to turn your eyes towards something, or to seem
sentence: {Look} at the beautiful sunset over the sea!
translation: Посмотри, какой красивый закат над морем!

definition: used to compare two people or things
sentence: My brother is taller {than} me.
translation: Мой брат выше меня.

definition: to have to have something because it is necessary
sentence: Plants {need} water and light to grow.
translation: Растениям нужны вода и свет, чтобы расти.

definition: not more than, or nobody or nothing except
sentence: There were {only} three people in the room.
translation: В комнате было только три человека.

definition: a period of 24 hours, or the time when it is light
sentence: We spent the whole {day} at the beach.
translation: Мы провели весь день на пляже.

definition: coming before all others in time, order or importance
sentence: January is the {first} month of the year.
translation: Январь — первый месяц года.

definition: later than something, or following something
sentence: We will go for a walk {after} lunch.
translation: После обеда мы пойдём гулять.

definition: a man, boy or male animal already mentioned, when he receives the action
sentence: Give {him} the keys when he arrives.
translation: Отдай ему ключи, когда он придёт.

definition: to the inside of a place, or used to show change
sentence: He walked {into} the room and sat down.
translation: Он вошёл в комнату и сел.

definition: to have an idea or opinion, or to use your mind
sentence: I {think} it will rain tomorrow.
translation: Думаю, завтра будет дождь.

definition: the number 2
sentence: I have {two} tickets for the concert.
translation: У меня два билета на концерт.

definition: above something, or across the top of it, or more than
sentence: The plane flew {over} the mountains.
translation: Самолёт пролетел над горами.

definition: to put something in someone's hand, or to let someone have it
sentence: Please {give} me the salt and the pepper.
translation: Передай мне, пожалуйста, соль и перец.

definition: some, used in questions and negative sentences, or no matter which
sentence: Do you have {any} questions about the lesson?
translation: У тебя есть вопросы по уроку?

definition: at that time, or after that, or in that case
sentence: We had dinner and {then} watched a film.
translation: Мы поужинали, а потом посмотрели фильм.

definition: the past of "can", or used to ask politely or talk about possibility
sentence: {Could} you open the window, please?
translation: Не могли бы вы открыть окно?

definition: a method of doing something, or a road or path to a place
sentence: Is this the {way} to the station?
translation: Это дорога к вокзалу?

definition: to the place or state you were in before
sentence: I will be {back} in five minutes.
translation: Я вернусь через пять минут.

definition: used to point at people or things that are near you
sentence: {These} shoes are too small for me.
translation: Эти туфли мне слишком малы.

definition: the speaker and other people, when they receive the action
sentence: Our teacher gave {us} a lot of homework.
translation: Учитель задал нам много домашнего задания.

definition: to discover something, especially by looking for it
sentence: I cannot {find} my glasses anywhere.
translation: Нигде не могу найти свои очки.

definition: in a good or satisfactory way
sentence: She speaks English very {well} for a beginner.
translation: Для начинающей она очень хорошо говорит по-английски.

definition: an object, or an idea, event or situation
sentence: What is that {thing} on the table?
translation: Что это за штука на столе?

definition: for the reason that
sentence: I stayed home {because} I was sick.
translation: Я остался дома, потому что заболел.

definition: correct or true, or on the side of the body where most people write
sentence: Your answer to the question is {right}.
translation: Твой ответ на вопрос правильный.

definition: a country or part of a country with its own government, or a condition
sentence: Texas is the second largest {state} in America.
translation: Техас — второй по величине штат Америки.

definition: to the greatest degree, or used to form superlatives
sentence: This is the {most} beautiful beach I have seen.
translation: Это самый красивый пляж, который я видел.

definition: a large amount of something
sentence: We do not have {much} time before the train.
translation: У нас не так много времени до поезда.

definition: to a great degree, used to make a word stronger
sentence: It is {very} cold outside today.
translation: Сегодня на улице очень холодно.

definition: in or to what place
sentence: {Where} did you put my jacket?
translation: Куда ты положил мою куртку?

definition: an adult male person
sentence: An old {man} was sitting on the bench.
translation: Старик сидел на скамейке.

definition: used to show that something is surprising or more than expected
sentence: He did not {even} say goodbye.
translation: Он даже не попрощался.

definition: used to say what is the right thing to do, or what is likely
sentence: You {should} see a doctor about that cough.
translation: Тебе стоит показаться врачу с этим кашлем.

definition: used to say that something is possible, or to ask for permission
sentence: It {may} rain later this afternoon.
translation: Позже днём может пойти дождь.

definition: in or to this place
sentence: Come {here} and look at this picture.
translation: Иди сюда и посмотри на эту картинку.

definition: very, or used to say that something is true
sentence: The film was {really} good, you should see it.
translation: Фильм был действительно хорош, тебе стоит его посмотреть.

definition: a living creature, especially a person
sentence: Every human {being} needs food, water and sleep.
translation: Каждому человеку нужны еда, вода и сон.

definition: very good, or very large or important
sentence: We had a {great} time at the party.
translation: Мы отлично провели время на вечеринке.

definition: more than is good or needed, or also
sentence: This soup is {too} hot to eat.
translation: Этот суп слишком горячий, чтобы есть.

definition: to telephone someone, or to give someone a name
sentence: I will {call} you when I get home.
translation: Я позвоню тебе, когда приду домой.

definition: to let someone see something, or to explain how to do it
sentence: Let me {show} you my new photos.
translation: Давай покажу тебе мои новые фотографии.

definition: away from a place or surface, or not on
sentence: The cat jumped {off} the table.
translation: Кошка спрыгнула со стола.

definition: earlier than something, or in front of
sentence: Wash your hands {before} dinner, please.
translation: Помой руки перед ужином, пожалуйста.

definition: for what reason
sentence: {Why} are you so late today?
translation: Почему ты сегодня так опоздал?

definition: to like someone or something very much
sentence: I {love} my family and my friends.
translation: Я люблю свою семью и друзей.

definition: continuing until now, or even so
sentence: Are you {still} waiting for the bus?
translation: Ты всё ещё ждёшь автобус?

definition: to say something to someone, or to give them information
sentence: Please {tell} me the truth about what happened.
translation: Пожалуйста, расскажи мне правду о том, что случилось.

definition: an activity or sport with rules that people play for fun or to win
sentence: Chess is my favorite {game} on rainy days.
translation: Шахматы — моя любимая игра в дождливые дни.

definition: a large number of people or things
sentence: {Many} people came to the concert.
translation: На концерт пришло много людей.

definition: not at any time; not ever
sentence: I have {never} been to Japan.
translation: Я никогда не был в Японии.

definition: measuring a great distance or lasting a great time
sentence: It was a {long} walk to the village.
translation: До деревни было далеко идти.

definition: used to point at people or things that are not near you
sentence: {Those} houses on the hill are very old.
translation: Те дома на холме очень старые.

definition: to begin doing something, or to begin to happen
sentence: The lesson will {start} at nine.
translation: Урок начнётся в девять.

definition: the Earth and all the people and things on it
sentence: She wants to travel around the {world}.
translation: Она хочет объехать весь мир.

definition: far above the ground, or great in amount or level
sentence: The mountain behind the village is very {high}.
translation: Гора за деревней очень высокая.

definition: to attempt to do something, or to test something
sentence: I will {try} to finish the work today.
translation: Я постараюсь закончить работу сегодня.

definition: the time between birth and death, or being alive
sentence: She has lived in this town all her {life}.
translation: Она прожила в этом городе всю свою жизнь.

definition: towards or in a lower place
sentence: The ball rolled {down} the hill.
translation: Мяч покатился вниз по склону.

definition: coming after all others, or most recent
sentence: December is the {last} month of the year.
translation: Декабрь — последний месяц года.

definition: to make it easier for someone to do something
sentence: Can you {help} me carry these bags?
translation: Можешь помочь мне донести сумки?

definition: from one side of something to the other
sentence: The train goes {through} a long tunnel.
translation: Поезд идёт через длинный туннель.

definition: one piece of something, not the whole
sentence: Which {part} of the film did you like best?
translation: Какая часть фильма понравилась тебе больше всего?

definition: during the time that something else is happening
sentence: Someone called {while} you were out.
translation: Кто-то звонил, пока тебя не было.

definition: a particular area, building or town
sentence: This is a good {place} for a picnic.
translation: Это хорошее место для пикника.

definition: the house or flat where you live
sentence: I usually get {home} at six.
translation: Я обычно прихожу домой в шесть.

definition: of the kind already mentioned, or used to make a word stronger
sentence: I have never seen {such} a big dog.
translation: Я никогда не видел такой большой собаки.

definition: to have something as one of its parts
sentence: The price does not {include} breakfast.
translation: Завтрак не входит в цену.

definition: to continue to have something, or to stay in a condition
sentence: You can {keep} the book; I have read it.
translation: Можешь оставить книгу себе, я её прочитал.

definition: having lived or existed for a long time, or of a particular age
sentence: My grandfather is eighty years {old}.
translation: Моему дедушке восемьдесят лет.

definition: to become different, or to make something different
sentence: The leaves {change} color in autumn.
translation: Осенью листья меняют цвет.

definition: a thing that is not named or not known
sentence: There is {something} in my shoe.
translation: У меня что-то в ботинке.

definition: to take part in a game or sport, or to make music
sentence: The children {play} football after school.
translation: Дети играют в футбол после школы.

definition: a place where children go to learn
sentence: The children walk to {school} every morning.
translation: Дети каждое утро ходят в школу пешком.

definition: exactly like another, or not different
sentence: We go to the {same} school.
translation: Мы ходим в одну и ту же школу.

definition: belonging to a particular person and nobody else
sentence: I want a room of my {own}.
translation: Я хочу собственную комнату.

definition: to move fast using your legs, or to manage a business
sentence: I {run} in the park every morning.
translation: Я каждое утро бегаю в парке.

definition: the last part of something, or the point where it stops
sentence: We will meet at the {end} of the week.
translation: Мы встретимся в конце недели.

definition: the two people or things together
sentence: {Both} my parents are doctors at the hospital.
translation: Оба моих родителя — врачи в больнице.

definition: each one of all the people or things in a group
sentence: I visit my grandmother {every} Sunday.
translation: Я навещаю бабушку каждое воскресенье.

definition: after the usual or expected time, or near the end of a period
sentence: Sorry I am {late}; the bus was slow.
translation: Извини за опоздание, автобус ехал медленно.

definition: the number 3
sentence: She has {three} children and a big dog.
translation: У неё трое детей и большая собака.

definition: an adult female person
sentence: A young {woman} opened the door.
translation: Молодая женщина открыла дверь.

definition: on all sides of something, or in a circle, or near

definition: in the space or time that separates two things

definition: a group of people who play or work together

definition: large in size or amount

definition: to experience an emotion or physical sensation, or to touch

definition: parents, children and other close relatives

translation: Моя семья ужинает вместе каждый вечер.

definition: to say words to someone, or to speak about something

definition: to say a question, or to request something

definition: below something, or less than

translation: Кошка прячется под кроватью.

definition: through the whole of a period, or at some point in it

translation: Пожалуйста, не разговаривайте во время фильма.

definition: to begin to be something, or to change into

translation: Он хочет стать пилотом.

definition: a word or sign such as 3 or 10, or an amount

translation: Какой у тебя номер телефона, на случай если ты понадобишься?

definition: a period of seven days

translation: Я хожу плавать два раза в неделю.

definition: the help a shop or hotel gives to customers, or a system for the public

translation: Обслуживание в этом ресторане очень медленное.

definition: a man, especially in informal speech

translation: Парень в магазине очень помог.

definition: a number of people or things that are together or connected

translation: Группа туристов стояла у фонтана.

definition: a person you know well and like, who is not family
sentence: I am meeting a {friend} for lunch.
translation: Я встречаюсь с другом за обедом.

definition: one more time
sentence: Could you say that {again}, please?
translation: Не могли бы вы повторить?

definition: coming immediately after this one in time or order
sentence: We are going to Italy {next} summer.
translation: Следующим летом мы едем в Италию.

definition: coming after the first one in order

translation: Это моя вторая поездка в Париж.

definition: a young person who is not yet an adult, or a son or daughter

translation: Каждый ребёнок в классе получил приз.

definition: used to ask for something politely
sentence: {Please} pass me the bread and the butter.
translation: Передай мне, пожалуйста, хлеб и масло.

definition: every one of two or more things, thought of separately
sentence: {Each} student has a desk and a chair.
translation: У каждого ученика есть парта и стул.

definition: not having or not using something

translation: Без билета войти нельзя.

definition: a large amount or number
sentence: We have a {lot} of work to do today.
translation: У нас сегодня много работы.

definition: a set of connected things or rules that work together
sentence: The school has a new computer {system}.
translation: В школе новая компьютерная система.

definition: opposed to something, or touching something
sentence: Our team played {against} the champions.
translation: Наша команда играла против чемпионов.

definition: used to say that something is necessary or very likely
sentence: You {must} wear a seat belt in the car.
translation: В машине обязательно нужно пристёгиваться.

definition: a large and important town
sentence: Paris is the capital {city} of France.
translation: Париж — столица Франции.

definition: to change position, or to go to a new house
sentence: Please {move} your car; it is blocking the road.
translation: Пожалуйста, переставьте машину, она перегораживает дорогу.

definition: certain that something is true, or without any doubt
sentence: Are you {sure} the shop is open today?
translation: Ты уверен, что магазин сегодня открыт?

definition: to take place, especially without being planned
sentence: What will {happen} if we miss the train?
translation: Что будет, если мы опоздаем на поезд?

definition: a particular situation, or a box for keeping things in
sentence: In that {case}, we will leave early.
translation: В таком случае мы уйдём пораньше.

definition: to allow someone to do something
sentence: My parents {let} me stay out late on Saturdays.
translation: Родители разрешают мне гулять допоздна по субботам.

definition: to help someone, or to agree with an idea and help it succeed
sentence: My friends {support} me when I have problems.
translation: Друзья поддерживают меня, когда у меня проблемы.

definition: to give money for something you buy or for work done
sentence: I will {pay} for the tickets.
translation: Я заплачу за билеты.

definition: at any time
sentence: Have you {ever} been to Rome?
translation: Ты когда-нибудь был в Риме?

definition: used to say that something is possible but not certain
sentence: It {might} snow tonight, so drive carefully.
translation: Сегодня ночью может пойти снег, так что веди осторожно.

definition: the bottom part of something, or a place where an army or company works
sentence: The lamp has a heavy metal {base}.
translation: У лампы тяжёлое металлическое основание.

definition: to have something in your hands or arms, or to contain
sentence: Please {hold} my bag for a minute.
translation: Подержи, пожалуйста, мою сумку минутку.

definition: to no longer have something, or to not win
sentence: Do not {lose} your keys again!
translation: Не потеряй ключи снова!

definition: an idea or opinion, or the act of thinking
sentence: I had a sudden {thought} about the problem.
translation: У меня внезапно возникла мысль насчёт этой проблемы.

definition: to finish doing something, or to no longer move
sentence: The bus will {stop} outside the school.
translation: Автобус остановится у школы.

definition: to move so that you face a different direction, or to make something rotate
sentence: {Turn} left at the next corner.
translation: На следующем углу поверни налево.

definition: costing no money, or not controlled or kept in a place
sentence: The museum is {free} on Sundays.
translation: По воскресеньям музей бесплатный.

definition: to put something somewhere carefully, or to fix a time or level
sentence: Please {set} the table for dinner.
translation: Пожалуйста, накрой на стол к ужину.

definition: the coins and paper notes used to buy things
sentence: I need to get some {money} from the bank.
translation: Мне нужно снять деньги в банке.

definition: the time when it is dark and most people sleep
sentence: It was a cold and windy {night}.
translation: Ночь была холодная и ветреная.

definition: an area of land with its own government, or land outside towns
sentence: Which {country} would you like to visit?
translation: Какую страну ты хотел бы посетить?

definition: the part of the body at the end of the arm, with fingers
sentence: She held the child's {hand} as they crossed the road.
translation: Она держала ребёнка за руку, пока они переходили дорогу.

definition: to go in front to show the way, or to be in charge of
sentence: Follow me and I will {lead} you to the exit.
translation: Иди за мной, и я проведу тебя к выходу.

definition: letters and parcels, or a message on a website, or a job
sentence: Did I get any {post} this morning?
translation: Мне что-нибудь пришло по почте утром?

definition: a part of a town, country or the world, or a space for a purpose
sentence: This {area} of the city is very quiet.
translation: Этот район города очень тихий.

definition: a person who is not known or not named
sentence: {Someone} left a bag on the bus.
translation: Кто-то оставил сумку в автобусе.

definition: the way things are arranged, or a request for goods, or a command
sentence: Put the names in alphabetical {order}.
translation: Расположи имена в алфавитном порядке.

definition: to have a particular sense, or to intend to do something
sentence: What does this long word {mean} in English?
translation: Что значит это длинное слово по-английски?

definition: an idea about what you will do, or a drawing of a building
sentence: Do you have a {plan} for the weekend?
translation: У тебя есть планы на выходные?

definition: not good, unpleasant, or of low quality
sentence: The weather was {bad} all week.
translation: Всю неделю была плохая погода.

definition: to tell people about something that happened, or to make a complaint
sentence: Please {report} any problems to the manager.
translation: Пожалуйста, сообщайте о любых проблемах менеджеру.

definition: to carry or take someone or something to a place
sentence: Please {bring} your passport to the office tomorrow.
translation: Пожалуйста, принеси завтра паспорт в офис.

definition: pages with writing or pictures fixed together inside a cover
sentence: I am reading a {book} about Africa.
translation: Я читаю книгу об Африке.

definition: to think that something is true or that someone tells the truth
sentence: I {believe} she is telling the truth.
translation: Я верю, что она говорит правду.

definition: a small number of; not many
sentence: Only a {few} people came to the meeting.
translation: На собрание пришло лишь несколько человек.

definition: to think that something is important, or to look after someone
sentence: I do not {care} what other people think.
translation: Мне всё равно, что думают другие.

definition: to or at a distance from a place or person
sentence: The children ran {away} from the dog.
translation: Дети убежали от собаки.

definition: on the side of the body where your heart is
sentence: Turn down the {left} street after the bank.
translation: После банка сверни на левую улицу.

definition: the work a person does to earn money, or a task
sentence: She found a new {job} in a bank.
translation: Она нашла новую работу в банке.

definition: a long thin mark, or a row of people or things
sentence: Draw a straight {line} across the page.
translation: Проведи прямую линию через страницу.

definition: buying and selling things, or a company
sentence: He runs a small {business} selling flowers.
translation: У него небольшой бизнес по продаже цветов.

definition: up to a particular time, and then stopping
sentence: The shop is open {until} nine in the evening.
translation: Магазин открыт до девяти вечера.

definition: something difficult that needs to be solved

translation: У нас проблема с двигателем машины.

definition: the top part of the body with the eyes, mouth and brain, or a leader
sentence: He hit his {head} on the low door.
translation: Он ударился головой о низкую дверь.

definition: a period of sixty minutes
sentence: The train journey takes one {hour}.
translation: Поездка на поезде занимает один час.

definition: one of the twelve periods a year is divided into
sentence: We are moving to a new house next {month}.
translation: В следующем месяце мы переезжаем в новый дом.

definition: the ability to control people or things, or electricity
sentence: The king had great {power} over his people.
translation: Король имел огромную власть над своим народом.

definition: the group of people who rule a country
sentence: The {government} promised to build new roads.
translation: Правительство пообещало построить новые дороги.

definition: to move a door or lid so that things can pass, or to start
sentence: Could you {open} the window, please?
translation: Не мог бы ты открыть окно?

definition: little in size or amount

translation: Мы живём в маленькой квартире в центре города.

definition: existing in fact, not imagined or pretended
sentence: Is that a {real} diamond or a piece of glass?
translation: Это настоящий бриллиант или кусок стекла?

definition: the spirit that people pray to and believe made the world
sentence: They pray to {god} every evening.
translation: Они молятся Богу каждый вечер.

definition: the highest part of something, or the best position
sentence: We climbed to the {top} of the hill before lunch.
translation: Мы забрались на вершину холма до обеда.

definition: to be the best or first in a game, race or competition
sentence: Our school team hopes to {win} the final on Saturday.
translation: Наша школьная команда надеется выиграть финал в субботу.

definition: big in size or amount
sentence: They live in a {large} house with a garden.
translation: Они живут в большом доме с садом.

definition: a social event where people eat, drink and enjoy themselves, or a political group
sentence: We are having a {party} for her birthday.
translation: Мы устраиваем вечеринку в честь её дня рождения.

definition: not the same as another person or thing
sentence: My sister and I like very {different} music.
translation: Мы с сестрой любим совсем разную музыку.

definition: difficult to do or understand, or firm and not soft
sentence: The last question in the test was very {hard}.
translation: Последний вопрос в тесте был очень трудным.

definition: to look at something for a period of time, or to be careful about something
sentence: We {watch} the news together every evening.
translation: Мы каждый вечер вместе смотрим новости.

definition: a female child or young woman
sentence: A little {girl} was playing with her dog.
translation: Маленькая девочка играла со своей собакой.

definition: a sentence that asks for information, or a problem to be discussed
sentence: The teacher asked me a difficult {question}.
translation: Учитель задал мне трудный вопрос.

definition: an important subject that people discuss, or a problem
sentence: Money is a big {issue} for many families.
translation: Деньги — большая проблема для многих семей.

definition: the front part of the head with the eyes, nose and mouth
sentence: She washed her {face} with cold water.
translation: Она умыла лицо холодной водой.

definition: the wish to know more about something, or money paid for borrowing
sentence: He has a strong {interest} in old cars.
translation: Он сильно интересуется старыми машинами.

definition: a human being; a man, woman or child
sentence: Only one {person} came to the meeting on time.
translation: Только один человек пришёл на собрание вовремя.

definition: used to add something that seems to disagree with what was just said
sentence: The hotel was cheap; {however}, the rooms were very clean.
translation: Отель был дешёвым, однако номера были очень чистыми.

definition: one of the flat surfaces or edges of something, or a team in a game
sentence: Write your name on the other {side} of the paper.
translation: Напиши своё имя на другой стороне листа.

definition: near the beginning of a period, or before the usual time
sentence: We took an {early} train to the mountains.
translation: Мы поехали в горы ранним поездом.

definition: to make something happen, especially something bad
sentence: Heavy rain may {cause} floods in the valley.
translation: Сильный дождь может вызвать наводнение в долине.

definition: to go away from a place, or to let something stay where it is
sentence: The train will {leave} in ten minutes.
translation: Поезд отправится через десять минут.

definition: a person who belongs to a group, club or organization
sentence: She has been a {member} of the club for years.
translation: Она уже много лет член клуба.

definition: something that happens because of something else, or a final score
sentence: The {result} of the match was two to one.
translation: Результат матча — два один.

definition: a description of real or imagined events, told for fun or in the news
sentence: Grandpa told us a funny {story} about his school days.
translation: Дедушка рассказал нам смешную историю о своих школьных годах.

definition: for everyone to use or know about, not private
sentence: The park is a {public} place, open to all.
translation: Парк — общественное место, открытое для всех.

definition: to want something to happen and think it is possible
sentence: I {hope} the weather will be nice tomorrow.
translation: Надеюсь, завтра будет хорошая погода.

definition: a rule made by a government that everyone must obey
sentence: It is against the {law} to drive without a license.
translation: Водить без прав противозаконно.

definition: the clear liquid that falls as rain and fills rivers and seas
sentence: Drink a glass of {water} before you run.
translation: Выпей стакан воды перед бегом.

definition: a single unit of language with a meaning, spoken or written
sentence: What does this {word} mean in Russian?
translation: Что это слово значит по-русски?

definition: to look at written words and understand them
sentence: I {read} a book every evening before bed.
translation: Я каждый вечер читаю книгу перед сном.

definition: to make letters or words on paper or a screen
sentence: Please {write} your name at the top of the page.
translation: Напишите, пожалуйста, своё имя вверху страницы.

definition: to appear to be a certain way
sentence: You {seem} tired today; did you sleep well?
translation: Ты сегодня выглядишь усталым, ты хорошо спал?

definition: to notice sounds with your ears, or to be told something
sentence: I could {hear} music coming from the next room.
translation: Я слышал музыку из соседней комнаты.

definition: to stay where you are until something happens
sentence: Please {wait} here until the doctor calls you.
translation: Пожалуйста, подождите здесь, пока врач вас не позовёт.

definition: to give someone something they need
sentence: The hotel will {provide} towels and soap.
translation: Отель предоставит полотенца и мыло.

definition: a road vehicle with four wheels and an engine for a few people
sentence: We drove to the coast in my father's {car}.
translation: Мы поехали на побережье на машине моего отца.

definition: this day
sentence: {Today} is my first day at the new job.
translation: Сегодня мой первый день на новой работе.

definition: containing as much as possible, or complete
sentence: The bus was {full}, so we waited for the next one.
translation: Автобус был полный, так что мы подождали следующий.

definition: the height or amount of something, or a stage in a scale
sentence: The {level} of the river rose after the rain.
translation: Уровень реки поднялся после дождя.

definition: not anything; no thing
sentence: There is {nothing} in the box; it is empty.
translation: В коробке ничего нет, она пустая.

definition: before now, or earlier than expected
sentence: I have {already} finished my homework.
translation: Я уже сделал домашнее задание.

definition: any thing, used in questions and negative sentences
sentence: Is there {anything} I can do to help?
translation: Могу ли я чем-нибудь помочь?

definition: a person who plays a game or sport, or a machine for playing music
sentence: He is the best {player} on our football team.
translation: Он лучший игрок в нашей футбольной команде.

definition: to fail to hit, catch or reach something, or to be sad someone is away
sentence: Hurry, or we will {miss} the train!
translation: Поторопись, а то мы опоздаем на поезд!

definition: to know what something means or why it happens
sentence: I do not {understand} this question; can you explain it?
translation: Я не понимаю этот вопрос, можешь объяснить?

definition: to stop living
sentence: Many plants {die} when there is no rain.
translation: Многие растения погибают, когда нет дождя.

definition: physical power or violence, or a group of soldiers or police
sentence: The door was opened by {force}.
translation: Дверь открыли силой.

definition: as much or as many as you need
sentence: Do we have {enough} chairs for everyone?
translation: У нас хватит стульев на всех?

definition: all things, or the most important thing
sentence: She lost {everything} in the fire.
translation: Она потеряла всё при пожаре.

definition: but, or in spite of that
sentence: He is very rich, {yet} he lives in a tiny flat.
translation: Он очень богат, и всё же живёт в крошечной квартире.

definition: the number 4
sentence: A table usually has {four} legs and a top.
translation: У стола обычно четыре ножки и столешница.

definition: one of the four parts of the year, or a period for an activity
sentence: Summer is my favorite {season} of the year.
translation: Лето — моё любимое время года.

definition: as soon as; when something has happened
sentence: {Once} you finish, you can go home.
translation: Как только закончишь, можешь идти домой.

definition: to put something together with something else, or to count numbers together
sentence: {Add} some sugar to the tea if you like.
translation: Добавь в чай немного сахара, если хочешь.

definition: of the color of snow or milk
sentence: She wore a {white} dress to the wedding.
translation: На свадьбу она надела белое платье.

definition: the activity of learning about a subject, or a piece of research
sentence: The {study} shows that children need more sleep.
translation: Исследование показывает, что детям нужно больше спать.

definition: to shut something, or to stop being open for business
sentence: Please {close} the window; it is cold.
translation: Пожалуйста, закрой окно, холодно.

definition: to see and talk to someone for the first time or by arrangement
sentence: Let us {meet} at the cafe at noon.
translation: Давай встретимся в кафе в полдень.

definition: relating to the whole country, not just one part of it
sentence: The team won the {national} championship.
translation: Команда выиграла национальный чемпионат.

definition: sounds made by instruments or voices that are pleasant to listen to
sentence: I like to listen to {music} while I cook.
translation: Я люблю слушать музыку, пока готовлю.

definition: a recording of moving pictures and sound
sentence: She posted a {video} of her cat online.
translation: Она выложила видео со своей кошкой в интернет.

definition: the power to make decisions and decide what happens
sentence: The pilot lost {control} of the plane for a moment.
translation: Пилот на мгновение потерял управление самолётом.

definition: having lived for only a short time; not old
sentence: My brother is too {young} to drive a car.
translation: Мой брат слишком мал, чтобы водить машину.

definition: fighting between countries or groups using weapons
sentence: Many people lost their homes during the {war}.
translation: Многие люди потеряли свои дома во время войны.

definition: to make something go to another place, especially by post or email
sentence: I will {send} you the photos tonight.
translation: Я отправлю тебе фотографии сегодня вечером.

definition: not correct, or not right morally
sentence: I took the {wrong} bus and arrived late.
translation: Я сел не на тот автобус и опоздал.

definition: at or to a great distance
sentence: The station is not {far} from here.
translation: Вокзал недалеко отсюда.

definition: a type or shape of something, or a paper with spaces to fill in
sentence: Please fill in this {form} with your name and address.
translation: Пожалуйста, заполните эту анкету, указав имя и адрес.

definition: to drop down towards the ground, or to become lower
sentence: Be careful not to {fall} on the ice.
translation: Осторожно, не упади на льду.

definition: a type or group of people or things
sentence: What {kind} of music do you like?
translation: Какую музыку ты любишь?

definition: despite the fact that; although
sentence: {Though} it was raining, we went for a walk.
translation: Хотя шёл дождь, мы пошли гулять.

definition: used to agree, or to answer that something is true
sentence: {Yes}, I would love a cup of tea.
translation: Да, я с удовольствием выпью чашку чая.

definition: to go after someone, or to do what you are told
sentence: Please {follow} me to the meeting room.
translation: Пожалуйста, следуйте за мной в переговорную.

definition: to get knowledge or a skill by studying or practicing
sentence: I want to {learn} how to play the piano.
translation: Я хочу научиться играть на пианино.

definition: to separate into pieces by force, or to stop working
sentence: Be careful, or you will {break} the glass.
translation: Осторожно, а то разобьёшь стакан.

definition: to make a person or animal die
sentence: Some plants can {kill} you if you eat them.
translation: Некоторые растения могут убить, если их съесть.

definition: to tell someone you are grateful for something
sentence: I want to {thank} you for your help.
translation: Я хочу поблагодарить тебя за помощь.

definition: something that is known to be true
sentence: It is a {fact} that the Earth goes around the Sun.
translation: То, что Земля вращается вокруг Солнца, — факт.

definition: used to say what is really true, often surprising
sentence: I thought he was French, but {actually} he is Swiss.
translation: Я думал, он француз, но на самом деле он швейцарец.

definition: to touch something quickly and with force
sentence: The ball {hit} the window and broke it.
translation: Мяч ударил в окно и разбил его.

definition: a period of sixty seconds
sentence: The bus will arrive in a {minute}.
translation: Автобус придёт через минуту.

definition: the brightness from the sun or a lamp, or a lamp itself
sentence: Turn on the {light}; it is dark in here.
translation: Включи свет, здесь темно.

definition: to join together as one group, or to bring people together
sentence: A common goal can {unite} the whole team.
translation: Общая цель может объединить всю команду.

definition: the cause of something, or why someone does something
sentence: What was the {reason} for the delay?
translation: Какова была причина задержки?

definition: of the darkest color, like the sky at night
sentence: He always wears a {black} coat in winter.
translation: Зимой он всегда носит чёрное пальто.

definition: a series of lessons on a subject, or the direction something moves in
sentence: She is taking a {course} in Spanish this year.
translation: В этом году она проходит курс испанского.

definition: a child, in informal speech
sentence: The {kid} next door is learning to ride a bike.
translation: Соседский ребёнок учится кататься на велосипеде.

definition: to do business, or to take action about a problem
sentence: We must {deal} with this problem today.
translation: Мы должны разобраться с этой проблемой сегодня.

definition: to keep doing something, or to start again after stopping
sentence: The rain will {continue} all night.
translation: Дождь продолжится всю ночь.

definition: the whole physical form of a person or animal
sentence: Exercise is good for the {body} and the mind.
translation: Физические упражнения полезны для тела и ума.

definition: to remain in a place or condition
sentence: Can you {stay} for dinner tonight?
translation: Можешь остаться на ужин?

definition: the part of a person that thinks, feels and remembers
sentence: She has a quick {mind} and learns fast.
translation: У неё живой ум, и она быстро учится.

definition: relating to most people or things, not detailed or specific
sentence: The book gives a {general} idea of the city's history.
translation: Книга даёт общее представление об истории города.

definition: a word with a special meaning, or one of the parts of a school year
sentence: The new school {term} begins in September.
translation: Новая учебная четверть начинается в сентябре.

definition: to use force or weapons against someone, or to try hard to stop something
sentence: The two boys began to {fight} over the ball.
translation: Двое мальчиков подрались из-за мяча.

definition: to practice for a sport, or to teach someone a skill
sentence: The athletes {train} six days a week.
translation: Спортсмены тренируются шесть дней в неделю.

definition: to get something by paying money for it
sentence: I need to {buy} some bread and milk.
translation: Мне нужно купить хлеба и молока.

definition: a thought or plan that comes into your mind
sentence: I have an {idea} for the weekend: let us go camping.
translation: У меня идея на выходные: поедем в поход.

definition: to let someone do something or let something happen
sentence: They do not {allow} dogs in the restaurant.
translation: В ресторан не пускают с собаками.

definition: a subject or situation that you must deal with
sentence: This is a private {matter} between the two of us.
translation: Это личное дело между нами двумя.

definition: every person; all people
sentence: {Everyone} in the class passed the exam.
translation: Все в классе сдали экзамен.

definition: the leader of a country without a king, or the head of an organization
sentence: The {president} gave a speech on television.
translation: Президент выступил с речью по телевидению.

definition: to have or use something together with others, or to give part of it
sentence: The two sisters {share} a bedroom.
translation: Две сестры делят одну спальню.

definition: to go or come back to a place, or to give something back
sentence: We will {return} home on Sunday evening.
translation: Мы вернёмся домой в воскресенье вечером.

definition: to control a car or other vehicle and make it move
sentence: My mother will {drive} us to school.
translation: Мама отвезёт нас в школу.

definition: a group of students who learn together, or a lesson
sentence: There are twenty students in my {class}.
translation: В моём классе двадцать учеников.

definition: coming next in time or order
sentence: We left the {following} morning at eight.
translation: Мы уехали на следующее утро в восемь.

definition: with each other, or in one place or group
sentence: We always have breakfast {together} at the kitchen table.
translation: Мы всегда завтракаем вместе за кухонным столом.

definition: complete; all of something
sentence: She ate the {whole} cake by herself.
translation: Она съела весь торт одна.

definition: to be on your feet, or to be in a particular place
sentence: Please {stand} up when the teacher comes in.
translation: Пожалуйста, встаньте, когда войдёт учитель.

definition: the place where a judge decides legal cases, or an area for playing a sport
sentence: The thief will go to {court} next week.
translation: На следующей неделе вор предстанет перед судом.

definition: written information about something, or the best result ever
sentence: Keep a {record} of everything you spend.
translation: Веди учёт всего, что тратишь.

definition: only one, or not married
sentence: Not a {single} person came to the meeting.
translation: Ни один человек не пришёл на собрание.

definition: to look at something carefully to make sure it is correct
sentence: Always {check} your answers before you finish.
translation: Всегда проверяй ответы, прежде чем закончить.

definition: the end of life
sentence: The whole village was sad about the old man's {death}.
translation: Вся деревня горевала о смерти старика.

definition: to make something new exist
sentence: The artist will {create} a new painting for the hall.
translation: Художник создаст новую картину для зала.

definition: to say words, or to know a language
sentence: Do you {speak} English or French?
translation: Вы говорите по-английски или по-французски?

definition: the number 5
sentence: I work {five} days a week.
translation: Я работаю пять дней в неделю.

definition: a person who is studying at a school or university
sentence: Every {student} must bring a dictionary to class.
translation: Каждый студент должен принести на занятие словарь.

definition: for each
sentence: The tickets cost ten dollars {per} person.
translation: Билеты стоят десять долларов с человека.

definition: perhaps; possibly
sentence: {Maybe} we can go to the beach tomorrow.
translation: Может быть, завтра мы поедем на пляж.

definition: a part of a building with its own walls and door, or space for something
sentence: My {room} has a big window and a desk.
translation: В моей комнате большое окно и письменный стол.

definition: a room or building where people work at desks
sentence: She works in an {office} in the city center.
translation: Она работает в офисе в центре города.

definition: relating to the area where you live or are
sentence: We bought vegetables at the {local} market.
translation: Мы купили овощи на местном рынке.

definition: to check how good or correct something is, or to ask someone questions
sentence: The teacher will {test} us on the new words tomorrow.
translation: Завтра учитель проверит нас на новые слова.

definition: to keep something in your mind, or to bring it back to your mind
sentence: I cannot {remember} where I put my keys.
translation: Не могу вспомнить, куда положил ключи.

definition: to become larger in amount or number, or to make something larger
sentence: Prices {increase} a little every year.
translation: Цены немного растут каждый год.

definition: one of the two parts of the face that you see with
sentence: She has blue eyes, and her left {eye} is slightly darker.
translation: У неё голубые глаза, а левый глаз чуть темнее.

definition: the number of years a person has lived, or a period of history
sentence: What {age} do children start school in your country?
translation: В каком возрасте дети идут в школу в вашей стране?

definition: things that people and animals eat
sentence: We need to buy {food} for the weekend.
translation: Нам нужно купить еду на выходные.

definition: the flames, heat and light made when something burns
sentence: They sat around the {fire} and sang songs.
translation: Они сидели вокруг костра и пели песни.

definition: the condition of your body and how well you are
sentence: Smoking is bad for your {health}.
translation: Курение вредно для здоровья.

definition: having a great effect, or mattering a lot
sentence: It is {important} to drink enough water.
translation: Важно пить достаточно воды.

definition: information about recent events, especially on TV or in the papers
sentence: I heard the {news} about the storm on the radio.
translation: Я услышал новости о буре по радио.

definition: inside a period of time, or inside a place
sentence: Please reply to this letter {within} three days.
translation: Пожалуйста, ответьте на это письмо в течение трёх дней.

definition: knowledge or skill from doing something, or something that happens to you
sentence: She has five years of {experience} as a nurse.
translation: У неё пять лет опыта работы медсестрой.

definition: to think carefully about something before deciding
sentence: We should {consider} all the options before we buy.
translation: Нам стоит обдумать все варианты, прежде чем покупать.

definition: something that happens, especially something important or planned
sentence: The concert was the biggest {event} of the summer.
translation: Концерт был главным событием лета.

definition: a drawing that shows how something will be made, or the way it looks
sentence: I like the simple {design} of this chair.
translation: Мне нравится простой дизайн этого стула.

definition: a particular day of the month or year
sentence: What is the {date} of your exam?
translation: Какого числа у тебя экзамен?

definition: the people who live in one area, or a group with shared interests
sentence: The whole {community} helped to clean the park.
translation: Вся община помогала убирать парк.

definition: to let someone or something go free, or to make a film or product available
sentence: The zoo will {release} the birds into the forest.
translation: Зоопарк выпустит птиц в лес.

definition: to get something that is given or sent to you
sentence: Did you {receive} my letter last week?
translation: Ты получил моё письмо на прошлой неделе?

definition: having the skill, power or chance to do something
sentence: She was {able} to swim across the whole lake.
translation: Она смогла переплыть всё озеро.

definition: facts or details about something
sentence: The website has useful {information} about the city.
translation: На сайте есть полезная информация о городе.

definition: used to show surprise, pain or understanding
sentence: {Oh}, I did not see you there!
translation: Ой, я тебя там не заметил!

definition: used to tell someone you are grateful
sentence: {Thanks} for the lovely dinner, Anna.
translation: Спасибо за чудесный ужин, Анна.

definition: a place where people study for a degree after school
sentence: My sister studies medicine at the {university}.
translation: Моя сестра изучает медицину в университете.

definition: a board with words or pictures giving information, or something that shows a fact
sentence: The {sign} on the door says "closed".
translation: На табличке на двери написано «закрыто».

definition: a group of people or things with the same qualities; a kind
sentence: What {type} of car do you drive?
translation: Какой тип машины ты водишь?

definition: to go past something, to give something to someone, or to succeed in an exam
sentence: Could you {pass} me the salt, please?
translation: Передай мне, пожалуйста, соль.

definition: to give something to someone in return for money
sentence: They want to {sell} their old car.
translation: Они хотят продать свою старую машину.

definition: instructions for a computer, a show on TV, or a plan of events
sentence: My favorite {program} is on at eight tonight.
translation: Моя любимая передача идёт сегодня в восемь.

definition: the amount of money needed to buy or do something
sentence: The {cost} of living in the capital is high.
translation: Стоимость жизни в столице высокая.

definition: relating to people, not animals or machines
sentence: The {human} body needs sleep every night.
translation: Человеческому телу нужен сон каждую ночь.

definition: a set of names, things or numbers written one after another
sentence: Make a {list} of what we need from the shop.
translation: Составь список того, что нам нужно из магазина.

definition: before the present time; in the past
sentence: I moved to this city ten years {ago}.
translation: Я переехал в этот город десять лет назад.

definition: relating to people living together, or to meeting people
sentence: Dancing is a good {social} activity.
translation: Танцы — хорошее занятие для общения.

definition: something that a person does, or a law made by a government
sentence: Helping her was a kind {act}.
translation: Помочь ей было добрым поступком.

definition: not difficult; simple to do or understand
sentence: The first exercise in the book is very {easy}.
translation: Первое упражнение в книге очень лёгкое.

definition: to move forward by putting one foot in front of the other
sentence: We {walk} to school because it is near our house.
translation: Мы ходим в школу пешком, потому что она рядом с домом.

definition: to pay money for something, or to use time doing something
sentence: Do not {spend} all your money on sweets.
translation: Не трать все деньги на сладости.

definition: the number 1,000,000
sentence: About a {million} people live in this city.
translation: В этом городе живёт около миллиона человек.

definition: one of two equal parts of something
sentence: I ate {half} the pizza, and he ate the rest.
translation: Я съел половину пиццы, а он — остальное.

definition: many times; again and again
sentence: We {often} go to the cinema on Fridays.
translation: Мы часто ходим в кино по пятницам.

definition: to show your choice in an election by marking a paper or raising your hand
sentence: People over eighteen can {vote} in the election.
translation: Люди старше восемнадцати могут голосовать на выборах.

definition: something that you hear
sentence: I heard a strange {sound} in the night.
translation: Ночью я услышал странный звук.

definition: a male child or young man
sentence: The {boy} kicked the ball over the fence.
translation: Мальчик перебросил мяч через забор.

definition: the amount of money you must pay to buy something
sentence: The {price} of bread has gone up again.
translation: Цена на хлеб снова выросла.

definition: careful study of a subject to discover new facts
sentence: Her {research} is about how children learn languages.
translation: Её исследование о том, как дети учат языки.

definition: what you can see from a place, or an opinion
sentence: Our hotel room had a lovely {view} of the sea.
translation: Из нашего номера открывался прекрасный вид на море.

definition: correct and based on facts; not false
sentence: Is it {true} that you are moving to Canada?
translation: Правда, что ты переезжаешь в Канаду?

definition: to start doing something, or to start to happen
sentence: The film will {begin} in five minutes.
translation: Фильм начнётся через пять минут.

definition: the direction that is on your right when you face the rising sun
sentence: Birds fly {south} for the winter.
translation: Птицы на зиму улетают на юг.

definition: a short piece of music with words that you sing
sentence: She sang a beautiful {song} at the wedding.
translation: Она спела красивую песню на свадьбе.

definition: events in the past, or the study of them
sentence: We learned about the {history} of Rome at school.
translation: В школе мы изучали историю Рима.

definition: to put food in your mouth and swallow it
sentence: We usually {eat} dinner at seven.
translation: Мы обычно ужинаем в семь.

definition: a small piece or amount of something
sentence: Would you like a {bit} of cake?
translation: Хочешь кусочек торта?

definition: a series of actions done to reach a result
sentence: Learning a language is a slow {process}.
translation: Изучение языка — медленный процесс.

definition: the mixture of gases around the Earth that we breathe
sentence: The mountain {air} is fresh and clean.
translation: Горный воздух свежий и чистый.

definition: to put something over something else, or to include a subject
sentence: {Cover} the pot and let the soup cook.
translation: Накрой кастрюлю крышкой и дай супу повариться.

definition: small in length, height or time
sentence: It is only a {short} walk to the beach.
translation: До пляжа идти совсем недолго.

definition: nearly; not quite
sentence: Dinner is {almost} ready; please sit down.
translation: Ужин почти готов, садитесь, пожалуйста.

definition: more than two but not many
sentence: I have read this book {several} times.
translation: Я читал эту книгу несколько раз.

definition: to give something formally, or to show information to people
sentence: She will {present} the prizes at the end of the show.
translation: Она вручит призы в конце шоу.

definition: paintings, drawings and other beautiful things made by people
sentence: We saw some modern {art} at the museum.
translation: Мы посмотрели современное искусство в музее.

definition: a bright point of light in the night sky, or a famous performer
sentence: The brightest {star} appeared just after sunset.
translation: Самая яркая звезда появилась сразу после заката.

definition: a piece of planned work with a clear aim
sentence: The students are doing a {project} about rivers.
translation: Ученики делают проект о реках.

definition: a structure with walls and a roof, such as a house or school
sentence: The tallest {building} in town is the bank.
translation: Самое высокое здание в городе — банк.

definition: quite; fairly
sentence: The test was {pretty} easy for most students.
translation: Тест был довольно лёгким для большинства учеников.

definition: something that you do, or the process of doing things
sentence: We must take {action} to protect the forest.
translation: Мы должны принять меры для защиты леса.

definition: not high; close to the ground, or small in amount
sentence: The sun was {low} in the sky.
translation: Солнце стояло низко над горизонтом.

definition: pleasant, kind or good to look at
sentence: It was {nice} to meet your parents.
translation: Было приятно познакомиться с твоими родителями.

definition: between small and large in size or amount
sentence: I would like a {medium} pizza, please.
translation: Мне, пожалуйста, среднюю пиццу.

definition: a place where people buy and sell goods, often outside
sentence: We buy fresh fish at the {market} on Saturdays.
translation: По субботам мы покупаем свежую рыбу на рынке.

definition: moving in a line next to or on something long
sentence: We walked {along} the river for an hour.
translation: Мы час шли вдоль реки.

definition: any person; used in questions and negative sentences
sentence: Does {anyone} know the answer to this question?
translation: Кто-нибудь знает ответ на этот вопрос?

definition: other, or in addition
sentence: Would you like anything {else} to drink?
translation: Хотите что-нибудь ещё выпить?

definition: to say that you will give or do something if the other person wants it
sentence: They {offer} free coffee to all customers.
translation: Они предлагают бесплатный кофе всем клиентам.

definition: feeling pleased and glad
sentence: The children were {happy} to see the snow.
translation: Дети были рады увидеть снег.

definition: to notice something, or to write it down so you remember it
sentence: Please {note} that the shop closes early on Sundays.
translation: Обратите внимание, что по воскресеньям магазин закрывается рано.

definition: the organ in your chest that pumps blood, or your feelings
sentence: Running is good for your {heart}.
translation: Бег полезен для сердца.

definition: a road in a town or city with houses or shops along it
sentence: We live on a quiet {street} near the park.
translation: Мы живём на тихой улице рядом с парком.

definition: to make something by putting parts together
sentence: They plan to {build} a new school here.
translation: Здесь планируют построить новую школу.

definition: to keep someone safe, or to keep money or time instead of using it
sentence: We {save} money every month for a holiday.
translation: Мы каждый месяц откладываем деньги на отпуск.

definition: almost certainly; very likely
sentence: It will {probably} rain this afternoon.
translation: Сегодня днём, скорее всего, пойдёт дождь.

definition: the speed at which something happens, or an amount measured against another
sentence: The heart {rate} goes up when you run.
translation: Когда бежишь, частота сердцебиения растёт.

definition: involving two or more countries
sentence: She works for an {international} company.
translation: Она работает в международной компании.

definition: a device used to talk to someone who is far away
sentence: My {phone} rang in the middle of the lesson.
translation: Мой телефон зазвонил посреди урока.

definition: a story shown in moving pictures at the cinema or on TV
sentence: We watched a funny {film} last night.
translation: Вчера вечером мы посмотрели смешной фильм.

definition: the time before now, and the things that happened then
sentence: In the {past}, people traveled by horse.
translation: В прошлом люди ездили на лошадях.

definition: able to happen or be done
sentence: Is it {possible} to change my ticket?
translation: Можно ли поменять мой билет?

definition: one thing of a kind, used to show what others are like
sentence: Give me an {example} of a healthy meal.
translation: Приведи мне пример здоровой еды.

definition: to think that something will happen or arrive
sentence: I {expect} the parcel to arrive on Monday.
translation: Я ожидаю, что посылка придёт в понедельник.

definition: in a short time from now
sentence: Dinner will be ready {soon}, so wash your hands.
translation: Ужин скоро будет готов, так что мой руки.

definition: to say that something is true, or to ask for something that is yours
sentence: Some people {claim} they saw a wolf in the park.
translation: Некоторые люди утверждают, что видели в парке волка.

definition: expected to happen or arrive at a particular time
sentence: The next bus is {due} at half past six.
translation: Следующий автобус должен быть в половине седьмого.

definition: to need something, or to officially demand it
sentence: Children {require} a lot of sleep.
translation: Детям нужно много сна.

definition: a drawing, painting or photograph
sentence: There is a {picture} of a horse on the wall.
translation: На стене висит картина с лошадью.

definition: a number of similar things that come one after another
sentence: The TV {series} has twelve episodes.
translation: В сериале двенадцать серий.

definition: to use violence to try to hurt someone, or to criticize strongly
sentence: The dog tried to {attack} the postman.
translation: Собака попыталась напасть на почтальона.

definition: different from usual, or important for a reason
sentence: Today is a {special} day: it is our anniversary.
translation: Сегодня особенный день — наша годовщина.

definition: an arrangement with a bank to keep your money, or a description of events
sentence: I opened a bank {account} when I started work.
translation: Я открыл счёт в банке, когда начал работать.

definition: a male child of a parent
sentence: Their {son} is studying to be a doctor.
translation: Их сын учится на врача.

definition: a statement about what you must or must not do
sentence: It is a {rule} that you must wear a helmet.
translation: По правилам нужно носить шлем.

definition: to start to be seen, or to seem
sentence: Stars {appear} in the sky when it gets dark.
translation: Звёзды появляются на небе, когда темнеет.

definition: a place where something is or will be built, or a website
sentence: The old factory {site} will become a park.
translation: Территория старого завода станет парком.

definition: the process of growing or changing into something better
sentence: The {development} of the town took many years.
translation: Развитие города заняло много лет.

definition: the time that will come after now
sentence: Nobody knows what the {future} will bring.
translation: Никто не знает, что принесёт будущее.

definition: to say or write something back when someone asks a question
sentence: Please {answer} the question in full sentences.
translation: Пожалуйста, отвечайте на вопрос полными предложениями.

definition: facts or numbers collected to be studied
sentence: The {data} show that sales grew last year.
translation: Данные показывают, что продажи в прошлом году выросли.

definition: the direction that is on your left when you face the rising sun
sentence: The wind is blowing from the {north} today.
translation: Сегодня ветер дует с севера.

definition: last; coming at the end
sentence: This is your {final} chance to buy a ticket.
translation: Это твой последний шанс купить билет.

definition: the early part of the day, from when you wake up until midday
sentence: I go for a run every {morning} before work.
translation: Каждое утро перед работой я бегаю.

definition: the people whose job is to catch criminals and keep order
sentence: Call the {police} if you see something strange.
translation: Вызовите полицию, если увидите что-то странное.

definition: an area of land used for farming or sport, or a subject of study
sentence: The cows are eating grass in the {field}.
translation: Коровы щиплют траву на поле.

definition: to choose something, or to take flowers or fruit from a plant
sentence: {Pick} any color you like for the walls.
translation: Выбери любой цвет для стен, какой тебе нравится.

definition: of the color of blood or a ripe tomato
sentence: She was wearing a bright {red} scarf.
translation: На ней был ярко-красный шарф.

definition: coming after the second one in order
sentence: This is my {third} cup of coffee today.
translation: Это моя третья чашка кофе за сегодня.

definition: the place where something is, or a job, or an opinion
sentence: Move the lamp to a better {position} on the desk.
translation: Переставь лампу на столе в более удобное место.

definition: the place or thing that something comes from
sentence: Fruit is a good {source} of vitamins.
translation: Фрукты — хороший источник витаминов.

definition: a very short period of time, or a particular point in time
sentence: Wait a {moment}; I will get my coat.
translation: Подожди минутку, я возьму пальто.

definition: having a lot of physical power, or not easily broken or changed
sentence: You need to be {strong} to lift this box.
translation: Нужно быть сильным, чтобы поднять эту коробку.

definition: the possibility that something will happen, or an opportunity
sentence: There is a good {chance} of rain tomorrow.
translation: Завтра вполне вероятен дождь.

definition: a short distance from
sentence: The school is {near} the station.
translation: Школа находится недалеко от вокзала.

definition: the act of moving one foot forward, or one stage in a process
sentence: Take one {step} forward and stop.
translation: Сделай один шаг вперёд и остановись.

definition: one or the other of two people or things
sentence: You can take {either} road; both lead to the town.
translation: Можешь ехать по любой из двух дорог, обе ведут в город.

definition: to choose what to do after thinking about it
sentence: We need to {decide} where to go on holiday.
translation: Нам нужно решить, куда поехать в отпуск.

definition: a very young child
sentence: The {baby} cried all night and nobody slept.
translation: Малыш плакал всю ночь, и никто не спал.

definition: a long hard surface for cars and other vehicles to travel on
sentence: This {road} leads to the next village.
translation: Эта дорога ведёт в соседнюю деревню.

definition: to ask someone to pay an amount of money for something
sentence: How much do they {charge} for a room?
translation: Сколько они берут за номер?

definition: quite; fairly, or used to say that you prefer something
sentence: It is {rather} cold for May.
translation: Для мая довольно холодно.
